# How the approaches hold up

<!-- Everything below this line is generated by robustness.py. -->

Every row is 100 tosses, position-only with 30 ms of close latency unless it says otherwise, at sigma_p = 2 mm, sigma lateral = 0.04 m/s and sigma vertical = 0.02 m/s except for what the table varies.  Caught is spec section 13.3's definition, with a 95% confidence interval.
